train_solver_model: train a source separation model by calling Solver.train() with data loaders, model, optimizer, and args
run_one_epoch: run a single training or validation epoch using Solver._run_one_epoch() with epoch index and cross_valid flag
serialize_checkpoint: save model checkpoint with optimizer state, history, and best state using Solver._serialize() to a file path
reset_from_checkpoint: load a previous checkpoint to resume training using Solver._reset() which restores model, optimizer, and history
configure_solver: initialize a Solver instance with data loaders, model, optimizer, and args including learning rate scheduling and checkpoint settings
